subject.title: fix(gateway): always enforce path containment for session transcript archive

question: Should archive/reset mutation continue to rename persisted cross-root `.../agents/<id>/sessions/*.jsonl` paths accepted by the resolver, or should those paths require migration into the current trusted store root first?
rationale: The merged resolver contract permits canonical cross-root paths for upgrade compatibility, but extending that read/resolve trust to filesystem mutation changes the security boundary and cannot safely be inferred from the current PR.

options.title: Require trusted-root migration
options.body: Archive only current validated store, agent, and legacy roots, and migrate older cross-root transcript references before runtime mutation.

options.title: Preserve cross-root mutation
options.body: Extend the resolver to return explicit trusted provenance and allow archive mutation only when that provenance proves the persisted cross-root path is intentional.

options.title: Accept structural paths directly
options.body: Treat any canonical `.../agents/<id>/sessions/<file>` path as mutable, preserving compatibility at the cost of a broader filesystem boundary.

recommendation.title: Require trusted-root migration
recommendation.body: Archive only current validated store, agent, and legacy roots, and migrate older cross-root transcript references before runtime mutation.

likelyOwner.reason: Merged the existing cross-root compatibility behavior and is the strongest available owner for the mutation-policy decision.
